title.zh: 美股总市值盘中一度蒸发3万亿美元，当前收窄至约2.5万亿美元
title.en: 美股总市值盘中一度蒸发3万亿美元，当前收窄至约2.5万亿美元

current_state.zh: US equities sold off sharply intraday on November 6, with the S&P 500 dropping as much as ~3.83% to around 7394 and total US market capitalization briefly shedding about $3 trillion before the loss narrowed to roughly $2.5 trillion.
